name: io.github.devinmlowe/engram
title: Engram
description: Cognitive memory for coding agents: hybrid recall, remember/forget, knowledge graph, nightly dreams.

packageArguments.description: Start the MCP server on stdio (bridges to a running engram HTTP daemon when one is healthy)

environmentVariables.name: ENGRAM_MCP_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Port of the optional engram HTTP daemon to bridge to (default 9907)

environmentVariables.name: ENGRAM_MCP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token forwarded to the HTTP daemon when it requires one

environmentVariables.name: ENGRAM_MCP_STANDALONE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to never bridge: always run the full server in-process
